scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,desktop -c cyan,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.sync:android: npm --prefix desktop run build && npm --prefix mobile run sync:android
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:android && npm --prefix mobile run build:debug
scripts.build:android:release: npm run sync:android && npm --prefix mobile run build:release
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix desktop run typecheck
